notes.title: Forgettable Dungeon: Update on Current Events
notes.notes:
Hey I just wanted to give everyone another update, I keep waiting for good news to share and it just keeps not materializing. 

As some of you may know I got very sick after PAX, with breathing and muscle complications. (I still don't believe this to be Covid-19, just a weird coincidence)

Unfortunately the side effects from this just haven't gotten better. Due to complications from being sick my sleep is now greatly disrupted, and now working from a computer randomly causes my chest to tighten up bringing the breathing issues back.

I was hoping this was just a slipped disc and it'd go away but it's sticking around for far too long.

So with all this progress has been slow.

I am still working on the game as much as I can, however I have to try and keep my health as my main focus.

That's sadly it for now. I hope everyone is taking care of themselves during all the crazy events of the world.

notes.title: The Forgettable Dungeon: Spooky Changelog
notes.notes:
Happy Halloween!

Today I have a special spooky themed update to The Forgettable Dungeon.

https://i.imgur.com/lMLKiCF.gif

The summoner will now appear in the graveyard at night conjuring spooky scary skeletons to fight his battles for him.

If you can manage to beat him you may be able to harness his powerful staff to conjure up some mayhem yourself.

https://i.imgur.com/Tz1nQqB.gif

There's also a new tree...?

I'd be careful turning your back to this tree at night.

In lighter news fall has hit the forest in the overworld, and even brought along some jack o' lanterns to light your path!

https://i.imgur.com/lz26rtb.png

Beyond these spooky changes I've also fixed a few crash bugs that some people were experiencing thanks to a lot of help from users in the discord.

If you run into any issues, have questions, or just want to say hi be sure to join the discord here.

https://discord.gg/0wDrfggwJYq1yjtF

That's it for now, hope everyone has a nice Halloween!

notes.title: The Forgettable Dungeon: Changelog r1592
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, just wanted to touch base really quick before I post the change log.

I appreciate all the feedback I've been receiving about the game, it's helping me figure out which direction to take certain features.

There's been a few issues that I'm trying to resolve as quickly as I can, some of which are resolved in this patch.

I'm aware that there's a crash glitch that some people have been getting, I'm working hard to try and figure out what the common thread is with this.

If you have experienced the crash or have other feedback please post in the forum or in the discord.

Discord: https://discord.gg/0wDrfggwJYq1yjtF

Forum: https://steamcommunity.com/app/375810/discussions/

Changelog:
  -- fixed case where you could gain control of the player during the intro cut scene and die
  -- fixed split screen not working properly if game is in full screen mode
  -- fixed case where certain switches wouldn't work with melee / ranged weapons
  -- added more specific message to timeout, to aid in joining LAN servers
  -- fixed animation with exploder enemy
  -- fixed "die once" checklist functionality 
  -- made shopkeepers a less floaty when attacked, and a bit tougher
  -- fixed cyclops health being set to too low

Thanks for taking the time to read this, I hope you've been enjoying the game!

Take care!

Unrelated gif for entertainment purposes:

https://i.imgur.com/ZPbEOZr.gif

notes.title: The Forgettable Dungeon: Early Access Release Date
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Just wanted to let you know that the game is going to be launching in early access on Monday October 21st!

I'm happy that the game is at a state where I can share it with more people.

It's going to be $19.99 with a 10% discount at launch.

With the early access announcement there's also a new trailer:

[previewyoutube=pMuk_1AIcUA;full][/previewyoutube]

If you don't got time for that here's a gif of some destruction and customization!

https://i.imgur.com/qVLLxiZ.gif
https://i.imgur.com/WAXE3WA.gif

Here's a link to the store page:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/375810/The_Forgettable_Dungeon/

( I have no idea if this is already linked somewhere with this new fancy announcement system )

Please help spread the word, wishlist and follows really help boost the games visibility for launch.

Thanks for following the game so far, I hope you'll enjoy it!

notes.title: Development update - Puzzles, Ghosts, and Gambling
notes.notes:
Hey everyone wanted to give you another update on development.

https://i.imgur.com/BdwCbQK.gif

Push block puzzles, can't have an adventure without them!

https://i.imgur.com/M73cP2M.gif

Ghost is a simple enemy, but I really enjoyed how he came out.

Though I do wonder what he's doing out during the day though...

https://i.imgur.com/TfZasB4.gif

Let's gambling as our forefathers used to, by walking into mysteriously red unmarked rupees.

https://i.imgur.com/ZQ1WdcH.gif

I've also added combo attacks and launchers, this should add some more variety to the combat.

https://i.imgur.com/FeziKVk.png

I've also added a minimap to help people get around easier in the new larger environments.

Thanks for taking the time to read this, take care!

notes.title: The Forgettable Dungeon Beta - r1047 Bug fixes, shiny magic items
notes.notes:
## Patch notes for r1047

Features:
-- default sword/mace can now be charged and then held for a little while before releasing
-- added highlight to objects that you can pickup/interact with when you're close to them
-- magical items like potions and scrolls now are shiny to make them stand out a bit more
-- finished implementing new cutscene object, no longer tied to specific objects

Changes:
-- staff projectile colors are now the same as their staff 
-- added error message when steam fails to start properly, preventing the game from running

Bug fixes:
-- fixed case where dungeon generator could create isolated areas that you'd get trapped in
-- fixed glyph trap messages not showing correctly 
-- fixed case where charged bow attack wouldn't use energy
-- fixed players floating above half walls, instead of actually colliding with them 
-- fixed particle emitters not transferring over network/splitscreen correctly. fire effects / warp tile effects
-- fixed transition wall details not displaying correctly during level transition 
-- fixed case where taking staffs down stairs would make them not shootable for a period
-- fixed being unable to jump/jetpack sometimes after level change 
-- fixed case where you could pick up the same item and remove it from world 
-- fixed confusion not confusing enough
-- fixed being unable to pick up hardHead ice world enemies 
-- fixed some cases of crashing while exiting/resetting on boss fights
-- fixed skelton john boss shooting right at start of cut scene
-- fixed being unable to throw dead players & idols down ladder
-- fixed shopkeeper not shooting shotgun
-- fixed falling through ice dungeon ice tiles
-- fixed boss cut scenes not sending over network
-- fixed edge case where black dungeon tile would be in a corner, in front of normal dungeon tiles

notes.title: The Forgettable Dungeon Beta - r942 - Bug fixes, misc changes
notes.notes:
## Patch notes for r942

Features:
-- game now pauses in single player when escape menu is opened
-- after beating boss stages, a special warp tile is now spawned instead of a ladder exit 
-- added optional heart container GUI variant for health bar

Changes:
-- heart container now fully restores health 
-- players are now temporarily invincible after they're teleported

Bug fixes:
-- gold and timer are no longer reset upon beating a dungeon, only on gameover 
-- boss snake no longer attacks after death 
-- sfx volume slider range was normalized to match music audio level 
-- boss snake now has death animation

notes.title: The Forgettable Dungeon Beta - R828 - Split Screen update
notes.notes:
The main new feature in this update is split screen support.

Currently split screen is windows only, and supports xbox 360 controllers, eventually it'll support all types of controllers.

Changelog: 
-- split screen mode added 
-- you can now navigate menus with the controller
-- your character now animates when you type text in game
-- steam friends invite option now only appears in multiplayer online servers
-- added a bit more support for generic controllers
-- you can now plug controllers in after the game has started and it'll detect them
-- fixed blindness not working in low quality mode
-- you can now reflect enemy projectiles with a charge attack
-- fixed case where players were falling through the ground on level transition
-- skeleton hands are now super effective against skelton john
-- added a spooky monster to the secret spooky theme
-- dungeon wall textures, and floor textures are now randomized again 
-- fixed case where boomerang would glitch out on closed doors 
-- changed behavior of love staff and polymorph on bosses 

That's it for now, if you guys find any bugs be sure to post them here or in the bug thread:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/375810/discussions/0/412446292758374622/
